temporal_beliefs.belief_statement: Monoliths and rapid single-file scripts are superior because speed of iteration trumps abstract modularity.
temporal_beliefs.reason_for_change: Discovered that monolithic scripts accumulate technical debt and break unpredictably under scale.

temporal_beliefs.belief_statement: Systems must be split into decoupled microservices with network APIs to isolate faults.
temporal_beliefs.reason_for_change: Distributed microservice networks introduced excessive networking overhead, latency, and operational fragility.

temporal_beliefs.belief_statement: Autonomous local modules with strict in-process interfaces, zero distributed bloat, and automated red-teaming provide optimal durability.
Cloud hosting is completely fine for personal tools as long as basic HTTPS is enforced.
temporal_beliefs.reason_for_change: Observed rampant telemetry collection, corporate surveillance, and unpredictable cloud API shutdowns.

temporal_beliefs.belief_statement: Personal memories and identity must run 100% locally with zero cloud leakage, loopback binding, and cryptographic manifests.
